s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we are playing the opposite game!

s04_03.text: And down it comes. Down, down, down.

s13_01.text: Tweet. I have no cookie. I am sad.

s13_02.text: Here is a cookie for you!

s13_03.text: Tweet tweet! Now I am happy!

s17_01.text: Hello, friends! Now it is night!

s22_01.text: Big and small. Up and down. Fast and slow.

s22_02.text: In and out. Loud and quiet.

s22_03.text: Open and closed. Happy and sad. Day and night!

s23_01.text: Thank you for playing with us!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!
